removed.name: Duvet Cover Set - Barn Buddies - Multicolor / 100x140cm

fields.name: Duvet Cover Set - Barn Buddies - Multicolor / 100x140cm
fields.description: Let your little one drift off peacefully under this duvet cover from the Barn Buddies collection. The sweet farm animals come together in a warm and cheerful all-over print on a soft Oatmeal background. From soft noses and curly coats to long ears and fluffy feathers, the print feels like one big cuddly embrace. The soft tones, including Soft Matcha and a Light Terra accent, create a calm and natural look that fits perfectly in any toddler or children’s room. Made from soft and breathable cotton, ensuring a comfortable sleep night after night. The practical opening makes it easy to insert the duvet, and the matching pillowcase completes the set. Available in 100x140cm and 120x150cm.
fields.Χαρακτηριστικό: Washing instructions: Wash at 40°C; Iron at medium temperature (max 150°C); Do not tumble dry; Do not steam

fields.name: Duvet Cover Set - Woolly - Multicolor / 100x140cm
fields.description: This duvet cover from the Woolly collection wraps the nursery in softness and comfort. The loving all-over print of a sheep family, with mama sheep and her little lambs close beside her, creates a warm and familiar feeling. Fluffy woolly coats, rounded noses and tiny hooves wandering playfully through the meadow bring the design to life in a gentle way. The sketch-style print, built up from soft neutral tones on a Sand background, gives the duvet cover a calm and refined look. A natural and harmonious base for any toddler’s or children’s room. Made from soft and breathable cotton, it helps your little one sleep comfortably night after night. The practical opening makes it easy to insert the duvet, and the matching pillowcase in the same lovely print completes the set. Available in 100x140cm and 120x150cm.
fields.Χαρακτηριστικό: Washing instructions: Wash at 40°C; Iron at medium temperature (max 150°C); Do not tumble dry; Do not steam

fields.description: Where the sun sets and the moon appears, it’s time to unwind. This sheet from the Over the Moon theme features a sweet print of little suns, moons, and tiny stars on a soft Oatmeal background. Playful and calm at the same time, it’s perfect for creating a warm and comforting feel in the cradle or cot. Combine it with a soft blanket in Sand, Oatmeal, or Milky Coffee and create a harmonious look for your little one.
